Fallon Sherrock Defeats World Darts No. 1 Luke Littler to Claim £501,000 Prize on Netflix Live Event

02 Nov 2026, 04:31 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.theguardian.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysFallon Sherrock secured a notable victory against world darts champion Luke Littler during a live Netflix entertainment event titled Beat Luke Littler, held at the Manchester Central arena. Competing as the 15th challenger of the evening, Sherrock claimed a £501,000 prize after defeating the world No. 1 in a single leg of darts.

A High-Stakes Clash in Manchester

Fallon Sherrock secured a notable victory against world darts champion Luke Littler during a live Netflix entertainment event titled *Beat Luke Littler*, held at the Manchester Central arena. Competing as the 15th challenger of the evening, Sherrock claimed a £501,000 prize after defeating the world No. 1 in a single leg of darts.

The event, hosted by Gary Lineker and Richard Osman, formed part of Netflix's push into live UK broadcasting. It faced direct competition from the final of BBC's *The Celebrity Traitors*, but sources reported steady audience numbers that grew following the conclusion of the BBC broadcast.

Eligibility Controversy and Defense

Sherrock's inclusion in the lineup drew some public debate prior to the event. Critics pointed to her MBE for services to darts, her appearance at the PDC World Darts Championship, and her victory at the inaugural Women’s World Matchplay in 2022, questioning whether she qualified as an amateur.

However, Netflix maintained that eligibility was determined strictly by whether a contestant held a PDC tour card. Because Sherrock has never held a tour card, she met the tournament's criteria. PDC president Barry Hearn supported this decision, noting that she was fully entitled to enter.

Reactions from the Players

Following her win, an emotional Sherrock expressed gratitude for the opportunity.

  • Fallon Sherrock: Stated that she was "lost for words" and proud of her performance, addressing the online backlash by emphasizing that she met all stated criteria and plays primarily for enjoyment.
  • Luke Littler: Praised Sherrock's performance as "world class" and expressed willingness to participate in a similar event in the future.

Practical Implications and Verification

  • Broadcast Availability: Viewers wishing to review the match or verify the broadcast details can check official Netflix programming listings and announcements.
  • Event Structure: The format was produced by Manchester-based Workerbee, aimed at bringing mainstream live events to the streaming platform.
